title: War, Force and Nonviolence
lead: Whether followers of Jesus may use force, serve as soldiers or fight in war. Jesus' teaching on not resisting the evil person and loving enemies (Matthew 5:38–48) and his rebuke of the sword in Gethsemane (Matthew 26:52) stand beside Israel's wars and Paul's words on the ruler who bears the sword (Romans 13:4). Churches have answered with just war teaching, with pacifism and with nonviolent resistance.
